messages:
Nina: Heads up: spotted multiple issues in the API reference for POST /v1/classify. Examples use `labels` (string) while the schema defines `labels` as array of strings. Also the response example omits `confidence_scores` and shows `label` as a single string instead of an object.
Omar: thanks for catching. That mismatch will break generated SDKs and confuse users. Can you list the exact files?
Nina: sure: docs/reference/classify.md (curl + python snippet), openapi/classify.yaml, and docs/_snippets/python/classify.md. I also added a tiny sample branch: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/compare/classify-fix.
DocsBot: lint: openapi/classify.yaml: response 200 content application/json schema mismatch (properties.confidence_scores missing). docs/reference/classify.md: example request uses "labels": "spam" (string) but schema: labels: type: array
Laila: We standardized on: request.body.labels -> array[string], and response.data[].prediction -> { label: string, confidence: number }. Also include usage.metrics for batch requests.
Connor: I'll update the OpenAPI schema to show labels: type: array, items: { type: string } and add example: ["spam","not_spam"]. For response sample we'll add confidence_scores as an array matching predictions order, and include prediction object shape.
Nina: small style rules: keep curl JSON in single-line for brevity in the curl snippet, but keep pretty JSON for response examples. Use 2-space indent. Add migration note: "Older clients might have sent labels as a single string; server accepts that for now but prefer array going forward."
Omar: Also check the Java SDK snippet in docs/_snippets/java/classify.md — it expects resp.get(0).getLabel() but our new shape is resp.get(0).getPrediction().getLabel(). Add that change and update unit tests.
DocsBot: PR #899 created: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/899. CI: docs-validate -> errors fixed in PR branch, docs build queued: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/2391
Laila: I'll push edits for the examples and OpenAPI in the PR branch, and add an entry in CHANGELOG under API changes (brief).
Nina: great. After CI green, please merge. We should also add a quick redirect note in the sidebar if anyone bookmarked the old example path.
Connor: merged after green. Deploying staging preview to https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/classify to verify rendering.
Nina: Verified on staging: examples look correct, Python snippet doctest passes. Closing thread after prod deploy. :white_check_mark:
